verdict.rationale: Ramp books travel in-product with policy status and per diem (ramp-docs-18, ramp-docs-19) and captures receipts automatically at swipe (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32). The CLI's `transactions ... trips` subcommand, its travel resource, and the MCP trips:read/trips:write scopes suggest transactions can be tied to trips. However, no evidence describes bookings, card spend and receipts gathering themselves into a single itinerary-linked report; Ramp's own framing is "no expense report filed". Missing for 10: documented automatic grouping of a trip's bookings, card charges and receipts into one trip view, explicit itinerary linkage of out-of-booking card spend, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
